messages:
maria: Deploybot paused the promotion to prod during the 02:00 change window, flagged an env-parity issue.

deploybot: PRECHECK FAILED: env-parity.secret_format -> INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX differs between staging and prod. Suggested action: hold promotion.

kevin: Ack. What exactly differs? staging vs prod?

deploybot: staging: "s3://redwood-cache/staging" (no trailing slash)
prod:    "s3://redwood-cache/prod/" (trailing slash + newline padding)
Also detected KVS_SECRET_TTL: staging=3600, prod=0 (unset).

sam: ugh. trailing slash + TTL mismatch could break our prefix-based cache invalidation. Lots of services assume normalized prefix.

maria: Did the deploybot compare helm values or paramstore?

kevin: It compared rendered helm values from the canary chart vs prod. I added a quick diff:

```
# staging rendered values (excerpt)
INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX: "s3://redwood-cache/staging"
INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL: "3600"
MODEL_VARIANT_PIN: "gptx-v2.3"

# prod rendered values (excerpt)
INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX: "s3://redwood-cache/prod/"
INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL: ""
MODEL_VARIANT_PIN: "gptx-v2.3"
```

sam: So variant pin matches, that's good. But TTL empty in prod means default 0 => indefinite keys. Risk: prod cache never expires after rollout, causing stale outputs when model weights change.

oncall: If we promote, we might see inference regressions and cache poisoning. Recommend rollback/hold until we reconcile.

maria: Agreed. Options: 1) quick hotpatch on prod to normalize prefix and set TTL=3600, 2) rollback the canary promotion, 3) run a migration to normalize existing keys. Which do we prefer during change window?

kevin: Hotpatch looks smallest blast radius but needs KMS access for secret write. Also need release notes update and an audit entry.

sam: Can we patch via a configmap patch (no image change)? deploybot can run a config-only promo if allowed.

maria: deploybot flagged config-only promos require an approval from oncall. @oncall can you approve a config patch to set INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL=3600 and strip trailing slash in INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX? Will do immediate canary then promote.

oncall: I can approve config patch. But we need a rollback plan: cmd to revert values and a test plan. Post-change smoke: 1) run /health, 2) run sample inference for model variant, check cache headers, 3) run small canary traffic for 10m.

kevin: Rollback snippet if needed:

```
# revert values
helm upgrade inference-service ./charts/inference -f prod-values.yaml --set INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX="s3://redwood-cache/prod/" --set INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL=""
```

sam: Note: prod-values.yaml currently has the trailing slash; we should avoid that. I'll prepare a minimal patch: set TTL and normalize prefix using helm --set.

maria: Also need to update release notes and internal changelog: add line about cache TTL and prefix normalization + risk mitigation for stale tokens. I'll draft.

maria: Draft release note line: "Hotfix: normalize INFERENCE_CACHE_PREFIX and set INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL=3600 to prevent stale inference cache after model rollouts."

kevin: Approving hotpatch during change window. I'm assigning myself to run the patch and monitoring.

oncall: Approved. Proceed with config-only canary (10% for 10m). If errors > 1% or latency increase > 10%, roll back.

deploybot: ACTION: queued config-only release by kevin, change-window=02:00-03:00, canary=10% 10m. Links: https://ci.internal/runs/38292

sam: Will also open a follow-up ticket to run a one-time migration to strip trailing slashes from existing keys and set a TTL where missing. That can be scheduled outside peak hours.

maria: Thanks team. After canary and smoke pass, we'll update the public release notes and close the loop with CS for any observed regressions.

kevin: Patch applied to canary at 02:12. Running smoke now.

kevin: smoke results: /health green, sample inference ok, cache header shows TTL=3600, no errors. Canary steady.

oncall: Canary metrics look healthy. Proceeding to gradual promotion.

maria: Promotion complete at 02:32, monitoring for 30m. I went ahead and added the release note line to the changelog.

sam: Filing follow-up: TICKET-4782 "Normalize ingress cache prefixes + TTL backfill".

maria: Closing thread when monitoring window ends. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: Monitoring clear at 03:05. No anomalies. Closing.
